assumptions.admission: two modeled reservations per receiver per round; failed attempts consume slots
assumptions.control_exchange: synchronous bounded substeps of each repair round
assumptions.fallback: every fourth Cuckoo round, plus filter saturation
assumptions.fresh_repair_schedule: eager baseline uses two shared slots; inventory modes permit one fresh slot, reserve remaining capacity for repair, then reuse unused capacity for fresh work
assumptions.loss: 25 percent per modeled control/payload reception in fault scenarios
assumptions.offer_and_request_model: two control payloads, each 48 + 32 * candidate_count bytes, each with four-byte framing
assumptions.owner_boundary: digest-verified synthetic payload reception; domain admission unexercised
assumptions.payload_wire_model: four-byte object-stream prefix plus unchanged synthetic bytes
assumptions.peer_state: eight caller-authorized slots, idle expiry at 32 ticks
assumptions.result_model: reserve a 48-byte advisory result plus four-byte framing per attempted payload; emit on complete digest-verified reception
